assumptions: Primer3's thermodynamic model and the Tm conditions named.
The weights given decide the ranking.
limits: Specificity is against the open record and the mispriming library given, not a genome.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which primer pairs in this window score best on Tm, dimers, hairpins, 3' stability, repeats, clamp and specificity under these weights?

description: The Primer Designer's own ranked search: scan the open record for primer pairs inside a product-size, Tm, length and GC window, score every candidate on Tm, dimers, hairpins, 3' stability, repeats, clamp and specificity under weights you set, and return the best N. With `task: existing`, supply one primer and it designs the mate. Emits the top pair so a downstream pcr_amplify runs on it. For a sequencing walk use design_sequencing_primers; for pydna's single-pair designer use design_primers.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

conditions.description: salt, magnesium, dNTP and oligo concentrations plus the salt-correction method the Tm window is measured in. Left unset it is filled from your reaction-conditions settings, as the panel's are. Advanced.

additives.description: DMSO and formamide, applied AFTER the nearest-neighbour Tm.

DMSOfactor.description: °C of Tm lost per % DMSO, as an explicit override. Supplying it WINS over `dmsoMethod`, and detaches the number from its citation.

dmsoMethod.description: which published DMSO depression sets the coefficient. Values: ahs01 (Ahsen et al. (2001) (0.75 °C per %)), mus81 (Musielski et al. (1981) (0.6 °C per %)), cul76 (Cullen and Bick (1976) (0.5 °C per %)), esc80 (Escara and Hutton (1980) (0.675 °C per %)).

fmd.description: formamide — percent when `fmdmethod` is 1, molar when it is 2.

fmdfactor.description: °C lost per % formamide (method 1). Papers report 0.6 to 0.72.

fmdmethod.description: 1 = linear % formamide (McConaughy 1969) · 2 = GC-dependent, molar (Blake & Delcourt 1996). Values: 1 (Linear %, McConaughy 1969), 2 (GC-dependent molar, Blake & Delcourt 1996).

method.description: which validated nearest-neighbour model and default buffer — santaLucia (pydna `tm_default`, Taq) or dbd (pydna `tm_dbd`, Phusion / Pfu-Sso7d). Values: santaLucia (SantaLucia (pydna tm_default, Taq)), dbd (DNA-binding domain (pydna tm_dbd, Phusion)).

nnTable.description: override the method's nearest-neighbour table; the buffer convention is unchanged.

saltcorr.description: Biopython salt-correction method 0–7 (0 = none). It moves the answer more than any other knob here: on a 24-mer at the Taq buffer the eight span 79.302 °C (method 0) to 66.009 °C (method 2).

selfcomp.description: both strands are one self-complementary oligo (the concentration term becomes dnac1 rather than dnac1 − dnac2/2).

excluded.description: spans no primer may sit on, as find_primer_snps' `excluded` emits them: a list of {start, end}, 0-based and end-exclusive, where start = end is an insertion between two bases. The amplicon may run across them. The panel's Avoid known SNPs. Advanced.

existing_forward.description: with `task: existing`, the forward primer to keep. Only applies when task is existing.

existing_reverse.description: with `task: existing`, the reverse primer to keep. Only applies when task is existing.

fwd_tail.description: 5' non-annealing tail added to every forward primer (a restriction site or adapter). The footprint, and so binding and Tm, is unchanged. Advanced.

mispriming_library.description: a Primer3 repeat library to screen every primer against. `none` skips the screen. Advanced.

n_pairs.description: how many ranked pairs to return.

region_end.description: 0-based inclusive end of the region to design within. Advanced.

region_start.description: 0-based inclusive start of the region to design within. Unset = the whole template. Advanced.

rev_tail.description: 5' non-annealing tail added to every reverse primer. Advanced.

target_end.description: 0-based inclusive end of the target. Advanced.

target_start.description: 0-based inclusive start of a target the amplicon must flank, with no primer on it. Advanced.

target_tm.description: the Tm each primer is scored toward. In °C.

task.description: `new` ranks candidate pairs; `existing` keeps the primer you supply and designs its mate.

tm_window_max.description: highest primer Tm accepted at all. In °C.

tm_window_min.description: lowest primer Tm accepted at all. In °C.

weight_cross_dimer.description: scoring weight for the `crossDimer` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_cross_end.description: scoring weight for the `crossEnd` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_di_repeat.description: scoring weight for the `diRepeat` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_end3.description: scoring weight for the `end3` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_gc.description: scoring weight for the `gc` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_gc_clamp.description: scoring weight for the `gcClamp` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_hairpin.description: scoring weight for the `hairpin` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_length.description: scoring weight for the `length` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_mispriming.description: scoring weight for the `mispriming` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_poly_x.description: scoring weight for the `polyX` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_self_dimer.description: scoring weight for the `selfDimer` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_self_end.description: scoring weight for the `selfEnd` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_specificity.description: scoring weight for the `specificity` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_tm.description: scoring weight for the `tm` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

weight_tm_pair.description: scoring weight for the `tmPair` penalty (0 switches it off). Advanced.

name: design_primer_pairs

forward.description: the top pair's forward primer (wire into pcr_amplify)

pairs.description: every returned pair in rank order: score, both primers (sequence, span, Tm, GC), product length, Tm and Ta

shortfall.description: why fewer pairs came back than were asked for; empty when the run was not short
